incidents.name: Juicebox V3 REVLoans fake loan source
incidents.notes: REVLoans.borrowFrom() registered the caller-supplied REVLoanSource (token + terminal) into _loanSourcesOf without checking it was a real registered JB terminal, so an attacker-deployed fake terminal inflated totalBorrowedFrom and let tiny revnet-token collateral borrow the revnet #3 ETH treasury out of JBMultiTerminal.

sources.ref: onchain review: REVLoans (verified source) created 2025-09-12 by 0x755ff2f75a0a586ecfa2b9a3c959cb662458a105 (not the attacker), no EIP-1967 Upgraded events; attack tx sent directly by the attacker EOA. Loss 21.77 ETH; DefiLlama records $52,000, BlockSec ~$50.7K.
